name: Wittman

scaling.scaled: 44/35 lb kettlebell, 95/65 lb power cleans, 20" box, 5 rounds. Steady triplet pacing — the workout has no natural rest built in.
scaling.beginner: 4 rounds: 10 Russian swings, 10 light hang cleans, 10 step-ups. Volume before load, always.

origin.summary: Honors Army Sergeant Jeremiah Wittman, 26, of Darby, Montana, killed in Zhari Province, Afghanistan, on February 13, 2010. Seven rounds of kettlebell swings, power cleans, and box jumps — a straightforward, grinding triplet.

description: Seven rounds of kettlebell swings, power cleans, and box jumps at even reps throughout.
source_notes: crossfit.com/heroes (official CrossFit Hero and Tribute Workouts page), retrieved 2026-07-08
